style_memory_rules.rule: Never use the word 'passionate'; open directly with solution evidence.
Always lead with quantified benchmark numbers (e.g. latency, throughput).
Avoid generic opening sentence: 'for your sample-job-001 deliverables, i recently c...'
User prefers concise proposals (<150 words). Cut superfluous context.

messages.body: Hi Alex! We reviewed your proposal and case study for the churn model. Are you available for a 15-min technical sync this Wednesday or Thursday?
